driving_question: q0097 — the lock's life-cycle (DEEP continuation, Doctorow b0274)
book: Information Doesn't Want to Be Free (Cory Doctorow, 2014)
best_collision: Apple is the lock's most aggressive enforcer (c01903, p.38-40), yet the lock's own store converts its paying customers into pirates (c01926, p.58-59) — the enforcer's refusal to sell is the lock's commercial function
quote: Digital locks turn paying customers into pirates... Locking users out doesn't reduce downloads, it reduces sales. (p.59)
mutation_note: the lock was never trying to stop the copy — it was manufacturing the pirate as a standing customer of the exclusion; the enforcer is the converter, and the converter is the enforcer's own storefront
